# Repo-local lint and check workflows boot up to 13 separate runners per PR

## Context

Sub-issue of Epic #20328 (*"Engine CI runs each tier only when a change can reach it"*), coordinated with `@neo-opus-grace` and `@neo-gpt-emmy` in `neomjs/neo#20328` (`#issuecomment-6662846915` and `MESSAGE:2c695615-05d4-45ef-b0d6-4fe64f5ac1b8`).

- **Live latest-open sweep:** checked latest 20 open issues on `neomjs/neo` (`#20340` down to `#20270`) at `2026-11-05T16:17Z`; no equivalent found.
- **A2A in-flight claim sweep:** checked `list_messages({ status: 'all', limit: 30 })` at `2026-11-05T16:17Z`; `@neo-opus-grace` confirmed (`MESSAGE:2c695615-05d4-45ef-b0d6-4fe64f5ac1b8`) that repo-local lint/check consolidation + `substrate-sync.yml` PR deduplication is owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` (`Skills #281` covers only the shared `neo-agent-skills` `pr-baseline.yml` jobs).
- **Memory Core rationale & own-assignment sweep:** queried Memory Core (`query_raw_memories` for `check-guard-ci-parity ScanSurfaceAlignment substrate-sync lint workflows`) and inspected `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs`, and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs`.
- **Design authority:** Epic #20328, `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs`, and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs`.

## The Problem

In `neomjs/neo`, every pull request currently triggers **up to 13 separate repo-local lint/check workflows** (in addition to `pr-baseline.yml`), each booting its own Ubuntu runner VM, running `actions/checkout@v7` + `actions/setup-node@v7` (+ `npm ci --ignore-scripts` in 6 of them, `~20–30s` each), and then executing a `<2s` Node script (`buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs`):

1. `.github/workflows/substrate-sync.yml` (`substrate`): runs `npm ci` (`26s`) + `npx --no-install neo-agent-skills-materialize --check` on every `pull_request` — **100% duplicating** `pr-baseline.yml`'s `baseline / Skills materialized` check (which is already required in `dev` ruleset `19087298`).
2. **12 repo-local Node guard workflows** (`guard-ci-parity-lint.yml`, `class-module-scope-lint.yml`, `content-root-derivation-lint.yml`, `engine-brain-boundary-lint.yml`, `fixed-sleep-lint.yml`, `jsdoc-type-lint.yml`, `check-relative-links.yml`, `theme-coverage-lint.yml`, `theme-value-file-lint.yml`, `check-examples-body-only.yml`, `check-theme-surfaces.yml`, `front-door-fingerprint.yml`):
   - The first 9 are the `mirroredGuards()` population governed by `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs`; the remaining 3 are standalone fast `buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs` workflows.
   - None of their job names (`substrate`, `lint`, `check`, `guard`, `check-fingerprint`) are required status checks in `dev` ruleset `19087298`.

## The Architectural Reality

Three repo-local guard contracts inspect `.github/workflows/`:

1. `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs` (tested by `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs`):
   - Scans `.github/workflows/*.yml` and verifies that every `lint-staged` guard script (outside `check-guard-ci-parity-registry.json`) is executed by at least one workflow gating `dev` pull requests.
   - `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs` pins `MIRROR_REL = '.github/workflows/guard-ci-parity-lint.yml'` and asserts that `guard-ci-parity-lint.yml` watches `VERDICT_INPUTS` (`package.json`, `.husky/pre-commit`, `.github/workflows/**`, `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity-registry.json`, `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs`).
2. `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs`:
   - Imports `mirroredGuards()` from `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs` and asserts that each guard's `SCAN_SURFACE` is covered by the `pull_request.paths` filter of its mirror workflow(s).
3. `node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs`:
   - Requires every cancelling `concurrency` block in `.github/workflows/*.yml` to be ref-keyed and rerun-safe (`github.run_attempt == '1' && github.ref || github.run_id`).

## The Fix

1. **Deduplicate `.github/workflows/substrate-sync.yml` on PRs:**
   - Remove `pull_request:` from `.github/workflows/substrate-sync.yml` so it runs on `push: branches: [dev, main]` (where post-merge drift is verified), while `pr-baseline.yml`'s required `baseline / Skills materialized` continues to gate every PR. Saves **1 full `npm ci` runner slot on every PR**.
2. **Consolidate the 12 repo-local `buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs` workflows into `.github/workflows/guard-ci-parity-lint.yml`:**
   - Run `actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/setup-node@v7`, and `npm ci --ignore-scripts` **once** in `.github/workflows/guard-ci-parity-lint.yml`, then execute all 12 `buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs` guards sequentially as direct `node ./buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs` steps in the same VM (`1` runner slot instead of up to `12`, eliminating 5 redundant `npm ci --ignore-scripts` installs).
   - Remove the 11 redundant workflow files (`class-module-scope-lint.yml`, `content-root-derivation-lint.yml`, `engine-brain-boundary-lint.yml`, `fixed-sleep-lint.yml`, `jsdoc-type-lint.yml`, `check-relative-links.yml`, `theme-coverage-lint.yml`, `theme-value-file-lint.yml`, `check-examples-body-only.yml`, `check-theme-surfaces.yml`, `front-door-fingerprint.yml`).
   - Update the stale-entry mirror-name assertion in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs` to match `guard-ci-parity-lint.yml`.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.github/workflows/substrate-sync.yml` | Epic #20328 & `pr-baseline.yml` (`baseline / Skills materialized`) | Runs on `push: branches: [dev, main]` only; PR check is already enforced by `baseline / Skills materialized` | Fails post-merge on `dev`/`main` if skills materialization drifts | Workflow header in `.github/workflows/substrate-sync.yml` | `node node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` |
| `.github/workflows/guard-ci-parity-lint.yml` & `check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs` | `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs` & `ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs` | Runs all 12 repo-local `buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs` guards in 1 runner job per PR/push instead of 12 separate workflows | Fails the job if any guard script exits non-zero | Workflow comments & `check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs` | `npm run test-unit` (`check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs` + `ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs`) |

- **Decision Record impact:** `none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `.github/workflows/substrate-sync.yml` no longer triggers a duplicate `npm ci` runner job on `pull_request` (covered by `baseline / Skills materialized`).
- [ ] The 12 repo-local `buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs` guard workflows are consolidated into `.github/workflows/guard-ci-parity-lint.yml` so a PR boots at most **1** runner job for all 12 guards instead of up to 12.
- [ ] `node buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs` and `node node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` both exit `0`.
- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs` pass under `npm run test-unit`.

## Out of Scope

- Changing the shared `neo-agent-skills` `pr-baseline.yml` workflow (`neomjs/neo-agent-skills#281`, owned by `@neo-opus-grace`).
- Modifying `file-size-guard.yml`, `spec-retirement-lint.yml`, `class-hierarchy-freshness.yml`, `check-package-contents.yml`, or `lint-guides.yml` (which have distinct trigger types, `fetch-depth: 0` range semantics, full docs/pack builds, or cross-repo checkouts).

## Avoided Traps

- **Do not orphan any `lint-staged` guard script from `.github/workflows/*.yml`:** `buildScripts/util/check-guard-ci-parity.mjs` fails `Guard CI Parity` if any non-exempt guard script is not executed by an unmasked `node ...` step in a `dev` PR workflow.
- **Do not weaken `ScanSurfaceAlignment.spec.mjs` or `check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs`:** Every directory in every guard's `SCAN_SURFACE` must remain covered by `guard-ci-parity-lint.yml`'s `on.pull_request.paths`, and `without('package.json')` / `without('.github/workflows/**')` must still unwatch those exact inputs in `check-guard-ci-parity.spec.mjs`.
